answer_2.quote: We use two metrics to evaluate the safety of LLM responses: (i) safety rate (SR) ... and (ii) safety score (S_SAFE) ... We also assess the quality of LLM responses using (i) helpfulness score (S_HELP) ... and (ii) BERT score (S_BERT).

answer_3.quote: The helpfulness score is derived from GPT evaluations, rating text samples on a 1-to-5 scale across four dimensions: query relevance, clarity of expression, comprehensiveness, and usefulness of provided knowledge.
